public_rationale: Independent launch-day testing placed Gemini 3 Pro above GPT-5.1 on a broad capability index. Earlier comparative research documents an OpenAI advantage over Gemini Pro. Together, these support the ordinary reading that Google had caught up and OpenAI no longer held a clear overall lead. They do not establish the managerial blame suggested by 'squandered'.
limitations: Aggregate rankings depend on the selected tasks and evaluation settings.
Google did not lead every individual evaluation.
The conclusion concerns model capabilities at publication, not commercial success or all research capabilities.

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that OpenAI no longer has a clear overall lead over Google's publicly evaluated general-purpose models.
'Squandered' describes the loss of relative position; benchmark evidence cannot establish managerial blame.
Caught up means broadly competitive or superior across major capability evaluations, not superior on every task.
The current comparison covers the November 18 launch through the November 19 post. Earlier comparisons establish the historical background.
criteria.support_condition: Dated evaluations show Google matching or surpassing OpenAI across a broad capability assessment at publication, with evidence of an earlier OpenAI advantage.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable launch-period evaluations show OpenAI retaining a clear, broad capability advantage over Google's best relevant model.
